text:
Aisha: Hey all — starting Fennec onboarding thread. Goals: smooth integration, 2-week pilot, and 20% DAU adoption in 30d.
Marta (Fennec): Hi! We'll surface orgID + SAML contact after this thread. Security lead Anil will join calls.
Luca: Do we need a staging API key or will Fennec provide IAM/KMS access?
Marta (Fennec): We'll provide staging creds and a service account. Sending secure details to Aisha/Ben.
Ben: I'll provision infra and request Dedicated capacity. Need orgID and expected RPS to size GPUs.
Luca: I'll handle prompts & embeddings benchmarks. Planning initial run Wed AM.
Aisha: Product-aligned success criteria: p50 <200ms (512 tokens), pass our eval accuracy thresholds, 20% pilot cohort DAU within 30d, no P0s for 7 days post-launch.
Marta (Fennec): We can supply a 500-user pilot cohort.
Ben: Timeline: Week0: access/infra; Week1: tuning + evals; Week2: pilot live + monitoring; End of Month: review & renewal check-in.
Aisha: Primary risks: access delays, prompt regressions, unexpected cost, compliance delays. Owners: Access=Marta, Prompts=Luca, Cost=Sophie.
Sophie: I'll set spend alerts and a daily cost digest. Recommend soft cap $X/day for initial burst and notify channel at 85% usage.
Luca: Enablement: 60min dev walkthrough (recorded) + 30min PM session + runbook. Propose Tue 11:00 PT for walkthrough.
Marta (Fennec): Tue 11:00 PT works; inviting PM and security.
Luca: Quick smoke curl I'll include in runbook: ```curl -X POST https://api.redwoodai.com/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -d '{"model":"redwood-1","prompt":"Summarize message"}'```
Ben: Opening Dedicated ticket now (infra-bot will post ticket ID). ETA ~72h post-approval.
infra-bot: Ticket created #D-4172, awaiting approval.
Aisha: Monitoring plan: per-route dashboards, token-level cost breakdown, latency SLOs. Sophie add daily digest to pilot channel.
Sophie: Done — daily digest at 08:00 PT and alert on 85% spend.
Aisha: Feedback capture: shared Notion doc + weekly 30-min syncs (Mon). Add prompt regressions or edge cases to Notion issues.
Marta (Fennec): We'll add integration questions and invite UX for qualitative feedback.
Aisha: Action items: Ben—raise Dedicated ticket & confirm ETA; Luca—run embeddings + post results Wed; Sophie—configure budget alert; Marta—share SAML/orgID + confirm cohort.
Ben: Ack, ticket raised.
Luca: Ack, posting runs after Wed.
Sophie: Ack, alert config done by EOD.
Marta (Fennec): Sending SAML + orgID to Aisha and Ben via secure channel now.
Aisha: Thanks all. I'll make the Notion kickoff page and schedule Mon 09:30 PT weekly sync. :thumbsup:
